title: Coefficient localization and local section multiplication on a ringed site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with Grothendieck topology $J$, let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings, let $U\in\mathcal C$, and let $f\in\mathcal O(U)$. Use the category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and the slice ringed site $\mathcal C/U$ with ring sheaf $\mathcal O_U$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. For each $\mathcal O_U$-module $M$, define $m_f(M):M\to M$ by multiplication on sections over $a:V\to U$ by $a^*f$. Define the coefficient localization $\mathcal O_U[1/f]$ to be the colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of the direct sequence $\mathcal O_U\xrightarrow{m_f}\mathcal O_U\xrightarrow{m_f}\cdots$ in module sheaves; equivalently, this is the sheafification of the presheaf $a:V\to U\mapsto\mathcal O(V)[1/a^*f]$. Let $j_U^*:D(\mathcal O)\to D(\mathcal O_U)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] be the functor induced by exact restriction of module sheaves. The maps $m_f(M|_U)$ form a natural endomorphism of module restriction; define $m_f:j_U^*\to j_U^*$ as the natural transformation induced by its termwise action on complexes and localization at quasi-isomorphisms.

proof.text: Let T be slice restriction, G the forgetful functor to abelian sheaves, and H the abelian-sheaf restriction. The componentwise definition gives T.Additive. The identity comparison T ⋙ G ≅ toSheaf R ⋙ H is definitional. The source-library preservation instance for H and Mathlib preservation by G transfer finite-limit preservation to T.

The cocontinuous sheaf adjunction for Over.forget U gives preservation of colimits by H, hence finite colimits. The source-library sheafification instance gives finite-colimit preservation by G. The identity comparison transfers this to T, and G reflects finite colimits because it reflects isomorphisms; consequently T preserves finite colimits.

The multiplication map is the presheaf sectionsSMul map. After applying the faithful forgetful functor, its naturality is exactly PresheafOfModules.sectionsSMul_naturality with overSections U f. The derived restriction and derived multiplication definitions then elaborate from the exactness conjunction.

proof_origin.place: Slice restriction through abelian-sheaf forgetful functor; PresheafOfModules.sectionsSMul_naturality for multiplication

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits. TopCat.Presheaf.SubmonoidPresheaf.localizationPresheaf and toLocalizationPresheaf concern topological spaces only; ModuleCat.Tilde.openToLocalization and toOpen concern affine schemes. None supplies localization on an arbitrary small ringed site. Read Mathlib/Topology/Sheaves/CommRingCat.lean:72-104.

No Mathlib hits. Direct project searches find PresheafOfModules.sectionsSMul and overSections in WeilConjectures/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Presheaf/InternalHom.lean:67-100,143-156; these are reused. No Sheaf module defines coefficient localization.
